description: Return your personal inventory — the list of objects you own that are stashed off-lot. KNOWN LIMITATION (freesoexperiment-1a9): inventory data arrives via DataServiceWrapperPDU updates that FSO.Server.Clients does not currently surface in-process for the bot. Until the DataService feed is wired, this op returns items=[] together with deferred=true and a deferred_reason string naming the blocker. Agents should treat deferred=true as 'I have no inventory visibility right now' — not 'my inventory is empty'. Prerequisite: you are joined to a lot (so the response correlates with session state). Effect: none — local-VM read, no outbound PDU. Cost: negligible. The response shape (items[], deferred, deferred_reason) is stable: once -1a9 closes, items[] will populate with real entries and deferred becomes false; agents written against this contract will light up without changes.
call_signatures: cf $CF query-inventory                                                               # no args; currently returns deferred:true (freesoexperiment-1a9)
common_mistakes: These are LOCAL VM reads — they reflect whatever your client-side replica VM shows, which may lag the authoritative state by 1-2 ticks.
Do not rely on query-inventory until freesoexperiment-1a9 closes — it returns deferred:true with items=[].
perception_hints: These ops return the same shape as the corresponding perception slice; use for fresh mid-turn snapshots
Perception already pushes this data at FSO_PERCEPTION_HZ — only call when you need data newer than the last tick
